_about: Built-in channel checks (R-CH-*). Every number here was read on an official page on the date given; numbers we could not verify are left out. Brands can override any value per workspace in Brand Kit -> Channels (stored in brand.channel_targets[channel]). Score targets are brand defaults, not platform numbers.

meta_ig_media.document: Meta for Developers: Instagram Platform, IG User Media (content publishing reference)

linkedin_ugc.document: LinkedIn API docs on Microsoft Learn: UGC Post API

constantcontact_subject.document: Constant Contact Knowledge Base: Optimize the subject line of an email

R-CH-IG-CAPTION.statement: Instagram captions can be at most 2,200 characters; longer captions are rejected or cut off.

R-CH-IG-HASHTAGS.statement: An Instagram caption can carry at most 30 hashtags.

R-CH-IG-MENTIONS.statement: An Instagram caption can carry at most 20 @ tags.

R-CH-IG-RATIO.statement: Instagram feed images must have an aspect ratio between 4:5 (portrait) and 1.91:1 (landscape).
R-CH-IG-RATIO.quote: Aspect ratio: Must be within a 4:5 to 1.91:1 range

R-CH-IG-WIDTH.statement: Instagram images narrower than 320 px are scaled up, so they look soft or pixelated.
R-CH-IG-WIDTH.quote: Minimum width: 320 (will be scaled up to the minimum if necessary)

R-CH-LI-LENGTH.statement: LinkedIn posts can be at most 3,000 characters.
R-CH-LI-LENGTH.quote: The maximum length of the text of a UGC Post is 3000 characters.

R-CH-EMAIL-SUBJECT.statement: Keep email subject lines to 60 characters or fewer; most inboxes cut longer ones, especially on phones.
R-CH-EMAIL-SUBJECT.clause: Subject line length (email-vendor guidance, not a hard limit)
R-CH-EMAIL-SUBJECT.quote: most email providers truncate subject lines to 60 characters

not_included: LinkedIn image size and aspect-ratio recommendations: no official LinkedIn page could be read on 2026-11-07 (LinkedIn Help blocks automated reading; the Posts and Images API pages give no image limits).
Instagram 'too many hashtags hurts reach' guidance: no official source found, so there is no soft hashtag check below the 30 limit.
Website meta tags: out of scope.
